@AutoConfigureMockMvc
 class ConverterControllerIntegrationTest {}

void convert_sectionLevelTwoRenderedAsH2() throws Exception{
        String asciidoc = "= Doc\n\n== Section Two\n\nContent.";
        String html = postAndDecodeHtml(asciidoc);
        assertThat(html).containsIgnoringCase("<h2");
        assertThat(html).contains("Section Two");
    }

private String postAndDecodeHtml(String asciidocSource) throws Exception{
        SourceContent sc = new SourceContent();
        sc.setData(base64(asciidocSource));

        MvcResult result = mockMvc.perform(post("/asciidoc")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(sc)))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andReturn();

        ConvertedResource resource = objectMapper.readValue(
                result.getResponse().getContentAsString(), ConvertedResource.class);
        return decodeBase64(resource.getContent());
    }
private String base64(String input){
        return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(input.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
private String decodeBase64(String encoded){
        return new String(Base64.getDecoder().decode(encoded), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }
